FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Inspection Coordinator, Phone: (555) 123-4567, Email: john.smith@carpetflooringsolutions.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Carpet & Flooring Solutions, we specialize in the professional installation of a wide variety of flooring options, including residential carpet, hardwood, laminate, and vinyl flooring. Our dedicated team of skilled installers is trained in the latest installation techniques and safety protocols to ensure high-quality workmanship on every project. We prioritize customer satisfaction by providing comprehensive consultations to help clients select the perfect flooring materials for their needs, and we uphold all required licenses and permits, ensuring compliance with local regulations. Importantly, we do not undertake any work involving hazardous materials like asbestos or lead, nor do we engage in the manufacturing or alteration of flooring products. Our operations include rigorous safety measures and regular employee training, alongside robust quality control processes to guarantee that all installations meet our high standards. We believe that our strong relationships with reputable suppliers, coupled with our commitment to a clean claims history, positions us as a reliable choice for flooring installation services.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in the installation or disturbance of hazardous materials such as asbestos or lead, nor does it manufacture flooring materials, cement, plaster, or other construction products. Additionally, we confirm that our operations do not take place in tourist attractions, caves, or similar venues, and we do not provide services for cemetery, church, or house of worship activities.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, while installing a carpet in a residential home, we encountered an issue where the carpet was damaged during transportation to the job site, resulting in a loss of $1,200. The status of the claim is currently closed as it has been fully paid by our insurance.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Saturday: 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM, Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and watchpersons on job sites to prevent theft and ensure safety.
